SASBDB entry SASDU29  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDU29/)

Publication: Molecular basis of CRX/DNA recognition and stoichiometry at the Ret4 response element
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.str.2024.07.004

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDU29/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
